card.name: Words just before disease or illness
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words right before the text names a sickness, such as make you, made ill, risk of, increase in, or exposure and. They appear in web text about toxins, pesticides, radiation and harm to health.

modes.label: Cause-illness verbs
modes.description: A verb like make or made, with its object, that leads to being sick or ill.
modes.example: Factory Farms Make<< You>> Sick. Let Us Count the Ways,

modes.label: Risk linking words
modes.description: A small word like of, in, or and that sits before cancer or disease after exposure or risk.
modes.example: an incremental increase in the risk<< of>> cancer. National Council on Radiation Protection,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying disease, illness or diseases next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a sickness is named in text about toxins or harmful exposure.
